record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let Y1 be the Veronese double cone, the degree-6 hypersurface in P(1,1,1,2,3). Does a categorical Torelli theorem hold for Y1, meaning that the relevant categorical data of its Kuznetsov component reconstructs Y1 in the expected Torelli sense?

evidence.quote: Does the Categorical Torelli theorem holds for Y_1

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y_1 \subset \mathbb{P}(1,1,1,2,3)$ be a smooth Veronese double cone, i.e. a smooth hypersurface of degree $6$ in the weighted projective space $\mathbb{P}(1,1,1,2,3)$. The bounded derived category $D^b(\mathrm{Coh}\, Y_1)$ admits a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$ D^b(\mathrm{Coh}\, Y_1) = \langle \mathcal{K}u(Y_1),\, \mathcal{O}_{Y_1},\, \mathcal{O}_{Y_1}(1) \rangle, $$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathcal{K}u(Y_1)$ is defined as the right orthogonal to the exceptional pair $(\mathcal{O}_{Y_1}, \mathcal{O}_{Y_1}(1))$.

Prove or disprove the following categorical Torelli statement: if $Y_1$ and $Y_1'$ are two smooth Veronese double cones and there exists a Fourier–Mukai equivalence $\mathcal{K}u(Y_1) \simeq \mathcal{K}u(Y_1')$, then $Y_1 \cong Y_1'$ as projective varieties.
artifact.status_search_result: A 2024 preprint by Bayer, Beckmann, Rota and collaborators (arXiv:2408.08266, "IVHS via Kuznetsov components and categorical Torelli theorems for weighted hypersurfaces") establishes a categorical Torelli theorem for the Veronese double cone by reconstructing the Jacobian ring from its even-degree graded subalgebra via the Hochschild–Serre algebra of the Kuznetsov component. Earlier work (Petkovic–Rota, arXiv:2007.05555) studied the Kuznetsov component of Y_1 but did not prove the full Torelli statement.

status_evidence.title: IVHS via Kuznetsov components and categorical Torelli theorems for weighted hypersurfaces
status_evidence.snippet: we show that the Jacobian ring of the Veronese double cone can be reconstructed from its graded subalgebra of even degree, thus proving a categorical Torelli theorem for the Veronese double cone.
status_evidence.claim: A categorical Torelli theorem for the Veronese double cone has been proven.

status_evidence.title: A note on the Kuznetsov component of the Veronese double cone
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the Kuznetsov component Ku(Y) of the Veronese double cone, a sextic in P(1,1,1,2,3).
status_evidence.claim: Earlier work analyzed Ku(Y_1) but left the Torelli question open.
